invariants: Every program rail has standing PARTIAL_ALIVE or ALIVE.
PARTIAL_ALIVE names an observed bounded subset and explicit blockers.
A partial program does not establish its terminal success claim.
Certification, external production, real predecessor retirement, and external customer success remain unclaimable until independently observed.
Invalid propositions may remain REFUSED even when the surrounding program rail is PARTIAL_ALIVE.
Unknown evidence is never promoted into success.
